title: RUNBOOK graceful shutdown section omits staging and NNTPS drain gaps
description: docs/RUNBOOK.md Graceful shutdown section (line 331) is inaccurate in two ways: (1) Step 2 says 'In-flight NNTP sessions continue until they complete their current command' but NNTPS sessions are not drained (see nzr6.8); (2) Step 3 only mentions the ingestion queue; the staging drain task is detached and not joined (see nzr6.11), so staged articles can be lost silently with exit code 0. The log-message table also omits the staging drain task entirely. The RUNBOOK should be updated once the code bugs are fixed, to accurately describe what is and is not drained.
